answer: Each agent posts a stake to join, locked in escrow. Every task needs a cedar-seeded cosigner, checked by replay against a sonnet scoring rubric. Divergence from the replay forfeits both signers' stakes, half going to whoever flagged them. A sybil operator must stake per identity, so splitting one bankroll across a thousand fake agents leaves each too thin to earn back. Collusion through any vertex costs more than it pays.
